data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-5: invalid ticket_id/key characters (path traversal, /, .., control chars, null bytes) rejected with structured error envelope + non-zero exit
- dd-6: writes exceeding max-byte ceiling rejected with structured error envelope naming limit and actual size

## Description

Add three private helpers to plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh:

- `_scratch_resolve_and_validate <ticket_id> <key>` — validates charset (rejects `/`, `..`, control chars 0x00-0x1F, null bytes, leading dots) and resolves to the per-ticket scratch path. On invalid input emits structured JSON error envelope `{status:"error",code:"invalid_id"|"invalid_key",reason:<text>}` to stdout and returns non-zero.
- `_scratch_atomic_write <abs_path> <payload>` — atomic write via same-dir tempfile + fsync(file) + rename + fsync(parent dir), implemented by extending the existing inline `python3 -c` block in ticket-lib.sh (mirrors the existing flock+rename pattern). Enforces max-byte ceiling (4096 bytes default). On overflow emits `{status:"error",code:"oversize",limit:<N>,actual:<M>}` and returns non-zero before any write.
- `_scratch_read_envelope <abs_path>` — reads a scratch file and returns its JSON contents on stdout; returns non-zero if the file does not exist or is empty.

These helpers are consumed by tasks 2, 3, 4, 6.

## TDD Test Approach (Given/When/Then)

Given a fresh checkout of ticket-lib.sh with the new helpers; When `_scratch_resolve_and_validate` is invoked with each rejected input class (path traversal, leading slash, embedded `..`, control char, null byte, leading dot); Then the helper exits non-zero AND stdout is a JSON envelope matching `{status:"error",code:...,reason:...}`. Given a 5000-byte payload and a 4096-byte ceiling; When `_scratch_atomic_write` is invoked; Then the helper exits non-zero, no file is created at the target path, and stdout is `{status:"error",code:"oversize",limit:4096,actual:5000}`. Given a valid 100-byte payload; When `_scratch_atomic_write` is invoked; Then the final file contents equal the payload AND no `*.tmp.*` sibling remains in the target directory.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: N/A (no format_check command configured)
- [ ] Charset validation rejects path-traversal/control-char/null-byte/leading-dot inputs with structured error envelope on stdout and non-zero exit
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-lib.sh
- [ ] Oversize writes (>4096 bytes default) rejected with structured error envelope; no file is created at the target path
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-lib.sh
- [ ] Atomic write leaves no `*.tmp.*` siblings on success
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-lib.sh
- [ ] New test file is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scratch/test-scratch-lib.sh

## File Impact

| Path | Action |
|------|--------|
| plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh | Edit |
| tests/scratch/test-scratch-lib.sh | Create |

## Retry Budget

MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
